subject: reasoning
question: EH 11 is related to CF 16 in a certain way. In the same way. JV 15 is related to HT 20. To which of the following is FN 13 related to following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First and second letters ⇒ (2) is subtracted the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• Last number ⇒ (5) is added

So,

 
• EH 11 is related to CF 16

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9261e8f22fbbc79dd9a2c35ee864984e36070e285f55192021fbf969bc26afcd.png] 

And,

 
• JV 15 is related to HT 20

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd82928943325bc9813faf81e4200744823bd1f382db3024fd335e17e5571891.png] 

​Similarly, 

 
• FN 13 related to

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1cb166475101ef162c6f6117fc883bf831a9bc6fe6c8248e7513aa915ca820d3.png] 

​Hence, "**DL 18**" is the correct answer.
